name: Boon Pack
body:
Your bond with your pack is unusually close.

Prerequisite: Animal Companions or familiar class feature, Handle Animal 5 ranks

Benefit: The abilities of your animal companions and familiars are calculated as though your class were 2 levels higher for each, to a maximum effective druid level equal to your character level. If you lose or dismiss an animal companion or familiar that has received this benefit, you may apply this feat to the replacement creature. Any new animal companion or familiar you gain also receives this benefit. For example, Dhorug is a level 10 druid with 3 velociraptor animal companions. His first one is level 5, the second is level 3, and the fourth is level 2. After taking boon pack, his velociraptors are now level 7, 5, and 4.

Special: This feat stacks with boon companion.
